'''Brian Kallenbach Big Blue Deck''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Brian Kallenbach]]
* '''Published:''' October 1998 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hoth: Echo Command Center (War Room)|Hoth-L-hothechocommandcenterwarroom.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Big Blue Deck
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PJP Big Blue Deck Kallenbach LS 1998.txt |Download]]
